description: This file defines a static class 'TestConfig' that loads environment variables and provide accessors for configuration settings used in UI automation tests for the OrangeHRM application. It loads environment variables from a .env file if present, and retrieves test parameters with fallback defaults.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A static class providing configuration settings for UI automation tests, including loading environment variables and retrieving test parameters.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, first from environment variables, then from NUnit test context parameters, with a default fallback.
